newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent marginally firmer but thinly traded.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent marginally firmer but thinly traded.

text.p: September Brent futures closed marginally higher on Monday, but trading was thin.
September SIMEX Brent closed at $19.00 per barrel, up five cents from London overnight.
But only 43 lots were traded in September.
Brokers said there was room for prices to move higher over the week, seeing firm bids from some players.
On NYMEX, September crudes last traded at $20.23, down five cents from New York's $20.28.
